response.subject: This week at Yale: free treats, a game night, a weighing
response.intro: Here are the events worth your time this week, with free food first and a mix of kinds of things to do.

picks.line: Free sweet treats before break, handed out at the College Street gate.
Free hot murga and a talk on culture, consent, and care.
A free sit-down dinner for the week before Thanksgiving break.
Board games and a relaxed night at AACC, open to anyone.
A Yale tradition on Beinecke Plaza, so go see the bulldog weighed.
Quick ten-minute wellness check-ins at the YSC Offline Oasis.
Mechanical engineering seminar with Jacob Notbohm, open to all.
